w1.trans: 我住在一栋建了20年的独栋房子里。
w1.trans_en: I live in a detached house that is 20 years old.
w1.point_en: Use 築 for how old a building is.

w1.trans: 电车从我家正后方开过。
w1.trans_en: Trains run right behind my house.

w1.trans: 换成节能的新冰箱后，电费便宜了。
w1.trans_en: After switching to an energy-saving fridge, the electric bill went down.

w1.trans: 在银行汇了房租。手续费很贵。
w1.trans_en: I transferred the rent at the bank. The fee was high.

w1.trans: 逃跑的银行劫匪终于被抓住了。
w1.trans_en: The fleeing bank robber was finally caught.

w1.trans: 那些垃圾会成为回收资源，请不要当可燃垃圾扔掉。
w1.trans_en: That trash becomes a recycling resource, so don't put it with burnable garbage.

w1.trans: 发烧出了很多汗，所以换了内衣。
w1.trans_en: I ran a fever and sweated a lot, so I changed my underwear.

w1.trans: 在外面吃太贵，所以我自己做饭。
w1.trans_en: Eating out is costly, so I cook for myself.

w1.trans: 大纸箱请当作资源垃圾扔掉。
w1.trans_en: Please put large cardboard out as recyclable trash.

w1.trans: 喝醉的上班族在街上撒野。
w1.trans_en: A drunken office worker is causing a scene in the street.

w1.trans: 做客时主人端出茶点，可以说「请别张罗」。
w1.trans_en: When a host serves tea, you can say 'please don't go to any trouble.'

w1.trans: 生气时大声喊叫。
w1.trans_en: To shout loudly when angry.

w1.trans: 花钱超过必要程度叫奢侈。
w1.trans_en: Spending more than necessary is extravagance.

w1.trans: 液体从有洞的容器漏出去。
w1.trans_en: Liquid leaking out of a container with a hole.

w1.trans: 把传单、海报从墙上揭下来。
w1.trans_en: Peeling flyers and posters off the wall.

w1.trans: 把穿不了的西装扔掉了。
w1.trans_en: I threw out a suit I could no longer wear.

w1.trans: 又不是小孩子，那种事别做了。
w1.trans_en: You're not a child, so stop doing that.

w1.trans: 那人摘下墨镜后，眼睛看起来很温和。
w1.trans_en: When that person took off the sunglasses, they had kind eyes.

w1.trans: 啤酒罐等请冲洗后再当不可燃垃圾扔掉。
w1.trans_en: Please rinse beer cans before putting them out as non-burnable trash.

w1.trans: 今年过年在家里悠闲度过。
w1.trans_en: I spent New Year at home at a leisurely pace.

w1.trans: 「一点心意，请收下」是送礼物时的说法。
w1.trans_en: 'It's nothing much, but please take it' is said when giving a gift.
option_translations_en: a small gift, please take it

w1.trans: 「高くつく」是花费变多，不是建筑物高。
w1.trans_en: 高くつく means it ends up costing more.
option_translations_en: travel costs made it more expensive
w1.point_en: 高くつく = ends up expensive.

w1.trans: 小猫撒娇地叫。
w1.trans_en: The kitten mewed in a spoiled voice.

w1.trans: 别用脚踢前面的座位。
w1.trans_en: Don't kick the seat in front of you.

w1.trans: 请趁热享用。
w1.trans_en: Please enjoy it before it gets cold.

w2.trans: 选定打印范围再打印。
w2.trans_en: Select the print range and then print.

w2.trans: 我是从大阪分公司调过来的田中。
w2.trans_en: I'm Tanaka, transferred from the Osaka branch.

w2.trans: 在网上检索了那家公司的信息。
w2.trans_en: I searched for that company's information online.

w2.trans: 不景气，要拿到奖金很难。
w2.trans_en: In a slump it's hard to get a bonus paid out.

w2.trans: 把旧文件删除了。
w2.trans_en: I deleted the outdated files.

w2.trans: 请把细节再具体说明一下。
w2.trans_en: Please explain the details more concretely.

w2.trans: 那件事明天商量吧。
w2.trans_en: Let's discuss that tomorrow.

w2.trans: 会议上被征求意见，很为难。
w2.trans_en: I was asked for an opinion in the meeting and didn't know what to say.

w2.trans: 一直唱歌是她的生存意义。
w2.trans_en: Singing on is what gives her life meaning.

w2.trans: 下个月的日程还没排。
w2.trans_en: I still haven't put together next month's schedule.

w2.trans: 把不好的地方改正确。
w2.trans_en: Correcting something so it is right.

w2.trans: 聚集到一处。
w2.trans_en: Gathering things into one place.

w2.trans: 当作不需要而去掉。
w2.trans_en: Removing something as unnecessary.

w2.trans: 和某物相称、合适的样子。
w2.trans_en: Being appropriate / a good match.

w2.trans: 电脑突然不动了。
w2.trans_en: The computer suddenly froze.

w2.trans: 不报销交通费，所以拒绝了那份兼职。
w2.trans_en: They don't pay travel costs, so I turned the job down.

w2.trans: 打开了那家公司的主页。
w2.trans_en: I accessed that company's homepage.

w2.trans: 把网上找到的图片贴进了文件。
w2.trans_en: I pasted an image from the internet into the document.

w2.trans: 复印纸快用完了，先买着吧。
w2.trans_en: We're about to run out of copy paper, so let's buy some.

w2.trans: 忙得连吃午饭的空档都没有。
w2.trans_en: I was so busy I didn't even have a moment to eat lunch.

w2.trans: 按日程把工作一件件做完。
w2.trans_en: I worked through the jobs on schedule.

w2.trans: 他拍上司马屁往上爬。
w2.trans_en: He got ahead by sucking up to his boss.
option_translations: 为了不拍马上司而出主意
option_translations_en: may I flatter because I'm tired

w2.trans: 铃木科长这会儿不在座位上。
w2.trans_en: Section chief Suzuki is away from his desk at the moment.
option_translations: 在公交上让座说成离开座位

w2.trans: 商量拖长了，下一个约会迟到了。
w2.trans_en: The meeting ran long and I was late for the next appointment.

w2.trans: 请把照片附在简历里寄出。
w2.trans_en: Please attach a photo to your resume and send it.
option_translations: 把多余图片从电脑附走
option_translations_en: attach a photo to the CV

w3.trans: 扮成圣诞老人的人扛着大袋子走。
w3.trans_en: Someone dressed as Santa is walking with a big bag on their shoulder.

w3.trans: 那支队伍功亏一篑没拿到冠军。
w3.trans_en: The team missed the title by a frustratingly small margin.

w3.trans: 轮胎被雨滑得撞上了墙。
w3.trans_en: The tires slipped in the rain and hit the wall.

w3.trans: 不能一直依赖父母。
w3.trans_en: You mustn't keep depending on your parents.

w3.trans: 连好友都背叛了，再也信不过任何人。
w3.trans_en: Even my best friend betrayed me; I can't trust anyone now.

w3.trans: 别含糊回答，不愿意就直说不愿意。
w3.trans_en: Don't give a vague answer — if you don't want to, say so.

w3.trans: 他总是叼着烟看报。
w3.trans_en: He's always reading the paper with a cigarette in his mouth.

w3.trans: 他总是笑着，是个开朗的人。
w3.trans_en: He's always smiling — a cheerful person.

w3.trans: 肺部检查拍了X光。
w3.trans_en: They took an X-ray in the lung exam.

w3.trans: 他净跟别人要烟抽，脸皮真厚。
w3.trans_en: He always cadges cigarettes — he's shameless.

w3.trans: 靠着、倚着。
w3.trans_en: To lean against something.

w3.trans: 心情变低落。
w3.trans_en: To feel down.

w3.trans: 想起往事觉得亲切怀念。
w3.trans_en: To feel fond nostalgia.

w3.trans: 说别人坏话。
w3.trans_en: To speak ill of someone.

w3.trans: 意见不合而争执。
w3.trans_en: To quarrel because opinions clash.

w3.trans: 在她耳边轻轻说了“我爱你”。
w3.trans_en: He whispered 'I love you' by her ear.

w3.trans: 出了麻烦问题，必须好好想着解决。
w3.trans_en: A messy problem came up and must be thought through.

w3.trans: 今天客人很多，忙乱的一天。
w3.trans_en: Lots of customers today — a hectic day.

w3.trans: 好吃，但天天吃也会腻。
w3.trans_en: It's tasty, but you get tired of it every day.

w3.trans: 牙疼还忍着继续干活。
w3.trans_en: My tooth hurt but I bore it and kept working.

w3.trans: 大雨过后迎来清爽的早晨。
w3.trans_en: After the storm came a refreshing morning.

w3.trans: 她总是偷别人点子，是个卑鄙的人。
w3.trans_en: She always steals ideas — she's cowardly/underhanded.

w3.trans: 小儿子长成了可靠的青年。
w3.trans_en: My little son has grown into a dependable young man.

w3.trans: 他很会抓要领，所以一路升职。
w3.trans_en: He's good at the knack of things, so he kept getting promoted.

w3.trans: 厚着脸皮拜托您送我去车站，不好意思。
w3.trans_en: It's shameless, but could you drive me to the station?

w4.trans: 犯了法的议员不久就会被逮捕吧。
w4.trans_en: That law-breaking assemblyman will be arrested before long.

w4.trans: 随着时间过去，疼痛渐渐消失了。
w4.trans_en: As time passed the pain gradually faded.

w4.trans: 我公司终于成功开发了新产品。
w4.trans_en: Our company finally succeeded in developing a new product.

w4.trans: 那个艺人出事以后完全不上电视了。
w4.trans_en: That celebrity hasn't appeared on TV at all since the incident.

w4.trans: 吃饭前先点杯啤酒吧。
w4.trans_en: For now let's order a beer before the food.

w4.trans: 奥运会明天终于开幕。
w4.trans_en: The Olympics finally open tomorrow.

w4.trans: 他很固执，一旦决定做就绝不会停。
w4.trans_en: He's stubborn: once he decides, he never quits.

w4.trans: 热门公寓一开卖转眼就卖光了。
w4.trans_en: The popular condos sold out in no time.

w4.trans: 怕被人看见，悄悄把信交给了田中。
w4.trans_en: I secretly handed Tanaka the letter so no one would see.

w4.trans: 比赛马上开始。
w4.trans_en: The match is about to start.

w4.trans: 塞得满满的样子。
w4.trans_en: Packed tightly.

w4.trans: 反复做同样的事。
w4.trans_en: Doing the same thing over and over.

w4.trans: 稍微、有点。
w4.trans_en: A little; somewhat.

w4.trans: 很多、充分。
w4.trans_en: A lot; plenty.

w4.trans: 下决心去做的样子。
w4.trans_en: Doing something resolutely.

w4.trans: 那起事故快满一年了。
w4.trans_en: It's almost a year since that accident.

w4.trans: 本不该说，却不小心把真话讲了出来。
w4.trans_en: I didn't mean to, but I accidentally told the truth.

w4.trans: 车里汽油还很充足。
w4.trans_en: The car still has plenty of gas.

w4.trans: 又不好吃又贵，那种餐厅再也不去了。
w4.trans_en: It wasn't very good and it was expensive, so I won't go back.

w4.trans: 她老早就离婚了。
w4.trans_en: She got divorced a long time ago.

w4.trans: 她居然其实是男的，简直不敢相信。
w4.trans_en: I can't believe she was actually a man.
option_translations_en: the dog is as smart as a person
no way she was a man
I have work today, no way

w4.trans: 突然这么说，一时也决定不了。
w4.trans_en: I can't decide just like that when you spring it on me.
option_translations: 突然说也一下子决定不了

w4.trans: 与其到处修，不如干脆把房子重建。
w4.trans_en: Rather than patching it everywhere, we might as well rebuild.

w4.trans: 妈妈老是发牢骚。
w4.trans_en: Mom is always complaining.

w4.trans: 与其说是猴子，那只猩猩更接近人。
w4.trans_en: That chimp is closer to a human than to a monkey.
option_translations: 与其说猴不如说接近人

w5.trans: 购物金额合计三万日元。
w5.trans_en: The purchase comes to 30,000 yen in total.
He's a master at making omelets.
option_translations_en: wrote a master on the form

w5.trans: 她对下属等下级非常严格。
那部电影里她的角色很不起眼。
w5.trans_en: Her role in that film was very low-key.

option_translations: 物事的作者是人气作家

w6.trans: 看您很忙，改日再来。
w6.trans_en: You seem busy, so I'll come again another day.

w6.trans: 哥哥在媒体相关的公司上班。
w6.trans_en: My brother works at a media company.

w6.trans: 我对鸡蛋过敏，所以尽量不吃含蛋的东西。
w6.trans_en: I'm allergic to eggs, so I avoid foods that contain them.

w6.trans: 她房间脏得让我目瞪口呆。
w6.trans_en: Her room was so dirty I was stunned.

w6.trans: 没事，这不过是普通感冒，过一阵就好。
w6.trans_en: It's all right — it's just a simple cold.

w6.trans: 用信用卡积分换了商品券。
w6.trans_en: I used credit-card points to get gift certificates.

w6.trans: 他的世界纪录时隔十年被打破了。
w6.trans_en: His world record was broken after ten years.

w6.trans: 这是先前会议上决定的。
w6.trans_en: This was decided at the earlier meeting.

w6.trans: 电脑中了病毒，数据全没了。
w6.trans_en: The computer got a virus and all the data vanished.

w6.trans: 挡路了，请把这把椅子挪一下。
w6.trans_en: It's in the way — please move this chair.

w6.trans: 由人手制作。
w6.trans_en: Made by human hands.

w6.trans: 事情推进的速度。
w6.trans_en: The speed at which things proceed.

w6.trans: 超市等付款的地方。
w6.trans_en: The place you pay in a supermarket.

w6.trans: 用手指撕成小块。
w6.trans_en: Tearing into small pieces with the fingers.

w6.trans: 数量或时间超过限度。
w6.trans_en: Going over a limit of amount or time.

w6.trans: 从前这一带有公园。
w6.trans_en: There used to be a park around here.

w6.trans: 未经允许请不要用别人的东西。
w6.trans_en: Don't use other people's things without permission.

w6.trans: 今天考试比预想难。
w6.trans_en: Today's exam was harder than expected.

w6.trans: 把今天的安排挪到了明天。
w6.trans_en: I shifted today's plans to tomorrow.

w6.trans: 她进公司第二年就结婚了。
w6.trans_en: She got married the year after joining the company.

w6.trans: 长颈鹿的特征是脖子长。
w6.trans_en: Giraffes are characterized by long necks.
option_translations_en: don't treat him as a trait

w6.trans: 他被老师提醒后改正了态度。
w6.trans_en: After the teacher warned him, he changed his attitude.

w6.trans: 感冒嗓子疼，所以含着糖。
w6.trans_en: My throat hurt from a cold, so I sucked on a candy.

w6.trans: 想不出答案，不禁哼哼起来。
w6.trans_en: I groaned, unable to find the answer.

w6.trans: 打了流感疫苗。
w6.trans_en: I got a flu vaccine.

w7.trans: 无意识地咬起指甲。
w7.trans_en: I chew my nails unconsciously.

w7.trans: 交了大学入学费。
w7.trans_en: I paid the university entrance fee.

w7.trans: 超时劳动换句话说就是加班。
w7.trans_en: Overtime work is another way of saying extra hours.

w7.trans: 世界和平是全人类共同的梦想。
w7.trans_en: Peace is a dream shared by all humankind.

w7.trans: 观众倾听长笛的精彩演奏。
w7.trans_en: The audience listened to a masterful flute performance.

w7.trans: 她出了名校，自尊心很高。
w7.trans_en: She went to a top university and has a lot of pride.

w7.trans: 大学之后就没见过，一晃20年。
w7.trans_en: I haven't seen him since university — it's been 20 years.

w7.trans: 许可证不能补发，请别弄丢。
w7.trans_en: Permits cannot be reissued, so don't lose yours.

w7.trans: 随口答应了，其实不该接下。
w7.trans_en: I said OK lightly, but I shouldn't have taken it on.

w7.trans: 这个过了赏味期限，还能吃吗？
w7.trans_en: This is past its best-before date — is it still okay?

w7.trans: 看东西时眼睛的神情。
w7.trans_en: The look in someone's eyes.

w7.trans: 知识习惯变成自己的本事。
w7.trans_en: Knowledge or habits becoming second nature.

w7.trans: 传达意志感情的身体动作。
w7.trans_en: Body movements that convey feeling.

w7.trans: 人突然情绪化地爆发。
w7.trans_en: Suddenly snapping in anger.

w7.trans: 季节交替的时候。
w7.trans_en: The turning point between seasons.

w7.trans: 飞机每隔一小时一班。
w7.trans_en: Planes leave every other hour.

w7.trans: 高水平的大学不容易进。
w7.trans_en: A high-level university isn't easy to get into.

w7.trans: 从模拟考结果看，合格没问题。
w7.trans_en: Judging from the mock exam, passing is a sure thing.

w7.trans: 药劲过了，牙又开始疼。
w7.trans_en: The medicine wore off and the tooth started hurting again.

w7.trans: 学生时代没钱，日子过得很紧。
w7.trans_en: As a student I had no money and every day was hard.

w7.trans: 新干线以前被称为“梦想的超特快”。
w7.trans_en: The shinkansen was once called the 'dream super express.'

w7.trans: 地铁票价涨了。
w7.trans_en: The subway fare went up.

w7.trans: 这家店的乌冬是关东风，汤色发黑。
w7.trans_en: This shop's udon is Kanto-style, so the broth is dark.

w7.trans: 这台机器每卖出一台就有很多利润。
w7.trans_en: This machine makes a large profit each time one is sold.

w7.trans: 他说话的神情活像他父亲。
w7.trans_en: The way he talks is just like his father.
option_translations_en: hard when newly using a PC

w8.trans: 车送去修了，想去也没交通工具。
w8.trans_en: The car's in the shop, so I have no way to get there.

w8.trans: 这张桌子稍加修理就能用。
w8.trans_en: This desk will be fine if we fix it up a little.

w8.trans: 排了三小时队，终于到手了。
w8.trans_en: I lined up three hours and finally got it.

w8.trans: 出门兜风忘了东西，中途折回家。
w8.trans_en: We went for a drive, forgot something, and turned back.

w8.trans: 上幼儿园前的孩子最费事。
w8.trans_en: Kids before kindergarten take the most looking after.

w8.trans: 孩子收到礼物高兴的样子浮现在眼前。
w8.trans_en: I can picture the child delighting in the present.

w8.trans: 15岁就上奥运会，真了不起。
w8.trans_en: Making the Olympics at 15 is really something.

w8.trans: 你说我那么说过，可我没那个印象。
w8.trans_en: You say I said that, but I have no recollection.

w8.trans: 我们家没那么宽裕，买不起那么贵的。
w8.trans_en: We don't have that kind of spare money.

w8.trans: 被人批评，听着心里难受。
w8.trans_en: It's painful to hear yourself criticized.

w8.trans: 连细节都操心。
w8.trans_en: Paying attention even to small things.

w8.trans: 运气好。
w8.trans_en: To be in luck.

w8.trans: 偷偷做不让人发现。
w8.trans_en: Doing something on the sly.

w8.trans: 正经、没什么古怪的样子。
w8.trans_en: Proper; nothing odd about it.

w8.trans: 把取消的票款退回来了。
w8.trans_en: I got a refund for the canceled ticket.

w8.trans: 他说话粗鲁，人却很温柔。
w8.trans_en: His language is rough, but he's kind.

w8.trans: 她做饭越来越好了。
w8.trans_en: She's gotten better at cooking.

w8.trans: 有空，所以去集会露了个面。
w8.trans_en: I had a spare moment so I showed my face at the meeting.

w8.trans: 东西很重，能帮一下忙吗？
w8.trans_en: It's heavy — could you give me a hand?

w8.trans: 都说那家牙医技术很好。
w8.trans_en: That dentist has a reputation for being skillful.

w8.trans: 尽偷懒瞎玩，迟早要吃苦头。
w8.trans_en: If you just slack off, you'll be in for it.

w8.trans: 同样的东西买两件就给打折了。
w8.trans_en: They gave me a discount when I bought two.
option_translations_en: bought two and got a discount
split a rock and carried it
looked up kanji at a discount

w8.trans: 电车费我先垫上了。
